description: Balanced positive (should trigger) and negative (should not trigger) prompts for the gauntlet-loop skill description.

positive.prompt: Keep iterating on this renderer until all the golden-image tests pass, and keep an auditable record of every attempt so we can review why candidates were rejected.
positive.reason: durable iteration with auditable candidate history

positive.prompt: Our agent keeps making the same tool-call mistake. Import the LangSmith traces, cluster the failures, and run controlled experiments on fixes without breaking anything else.

positive.prompt: Improve p95 latency of this service but do not let error rate or memory regress; only accept changes that prove the improvement on held-out benchmarks.

Draft this survey paper section by section, but track every claim against its sources, detect contradictions, and hold out some fact checks to verify the final draft.
positive.reason: spec-grounded research campaign with held-out verification

positive.prompt: Fork the state right before the failure we recorded yesterday, try three alternative fixes in isolated branches, and compare them against the baseline fairly.
